text: 下面进入大作文 05 · 人与自然与生态保护：绿水青山与绿色低碳发展，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段 · 荒山变青山】用 in which 定从和 with 独立主格写活“荒山变成绿林，鱼在清澈河水畅游”：
The striking cartoon vividly presents a magnificent scene in which barren hills turn into lush green forests, with fish swimming freely in crystal-clear rivers.
手术刀点拨：turn into 和 with fish swimming freely 简单精准，避免拼写不确定的生僻生态学词汇。
【二段 · 批判短视与空喊口号】改写“短视企业没能权衡环境代价，只靠口号远远不够”：
Short-sighted companies often fail to weigh the severe cost, and relying solely on slogans is far from enough to protect nature.
手术刀点拨：连续嵌入 fail to 与 far from enough 两块免 not 积木，批判力度克制到位。
【尾段 · 以环境换增长零容忍】用 at the heavy expense of + Only in harmony with nature can mankind 收尾：
Economic advancement must never be pursued at the heavy expense of a damaged environment. Only in harmony with nature can mankind secure a green, promising future.
手术刀点拨：Only in harmony with nature 置句首接 can mankind，与环保主题天然契合。
